acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we can absolutely match existing trim colors or help you select new ones. For color matching, we use advanced color-matching technology or professional swatch comparisons to accurately replicate your current trim color. If you're looking for a change, our team can provide expert recommendations based on your home's aesthetic, natural lighting, and wall colors. We can also help you choose a consistent trim color across different rooms, which often enhances flow and cohesion throughout your home in areas like Berkeley and Albany.
